evidenceClasses.analysis-scope: An explicit boundary against interpreting nearness as identity, outcome as input, or an unevaluated quantity as zero.
evidenceClasses.declared-distance-profile: A deterministic normalized RMS comparison under one explicit window and field scope.
evidenceClasses.selection-biased-outcome-comparison: An outcome difference for a pair deliberately selected using that outcome.
evidenceClasses.source-lock: Exact NASA archive and consumed-member locks.
evidenceClasses.source-projected-endpoint: The last observed test row, containing settings and sensors only.
evidenceClasses.source-projected-observed-prefix: Cycles 1 through the final observed test row; no future rows.
evidenceClasses.source-provided-test-rul: A separately supplied outcome, never an input to a distance profile.

boundary.note: The highlighted pair is near only under one declared profile. Its 95-cycle RUL gap was used to select the demonstration and is not predictive performance. Historical Load is undefined for this case.
boundary.summary: Current frames, observed histories, latent health, provided RUL, and predictions remain distinct layers.
